name: coll_tp8_col_mgb-wt2b-81025983b
purpose: q13-coll root cause of wt1 PPL-0111: the E face carries 2,816 pins (10x128 relay/held/out + sr/sx 2x384 + 6x128 queue heads) but 237.6 um of M4 at the 2-track pin pitch (0.096) holds 2,460 slots. Physical fix without an M6 grant and without area growth: re-shape the pin-bound leaf to 270.0 x 280.8 um (75,816 um2 vs 76,982): E face 2910 slots >= 2,816, W face 1,792 pins; same RTL (c6a0c7392 leaf, exact 9 / prod 3 / owner mutant), same registered edges, 0 cycles. Also carries the macro pin-edge M5 access guard (9 SRAMs; col_tile ct1-ct5 root cause). Variant b (tighter face, squarer).
